approaches.name: AMI smart metering with automated data collection, billing and outage management
approaches.description: Two-way smart meters with automated meter data, CRM billing, remote disconnection and outage/complaint management cut losses and raise collection rates. Practices: smart-meter AMI with automated data collection and CRM billing; AMI smart metering with automated data collection and billing; AMI remote disconnection to raise collection rates; IRMS integrated into AMI for outage and complaint response.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: two-way smart metering with automated billing data - cue: 'smart meter' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 2 round(s); context expanded; final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: The AMI will comprise: (a) installation of smart meters (with 2-way remote communication);

extra_evidence.text: (b) meter data collection and management (with automated data collection); and (c) billing system (with structured customer accounts and billing procedure based on accurate measured data, including customer relationship management (CRM)).
Meter data collection and management (with automated data collection); c.

Under the Program, BT will extend the use of AMI to cities of Istaravshan, Isfara, and Konibodom city, which will contribute to further reductions in energy loss rates and increase in collection rates for billed electricity, thus substantially contributing also into the improvement of company’s overall revenue recognition.
Remote disconnection functionality of the AMI helped to achieve overall collection rate of 93.6 percent in 2017, with 97.5 percent in the residential category.50 43.
It is recommended to include into the AMI, to be supported under the Program, a new IRMS.
It will support better network operations and would allow to better respond to client claims and complaints related to outages and other issues with electricity supply.
